record.label: Fixed-rank CP3 old-column summaries
record.summary: At the largest defensible 2,048-column state, earliest-prefix, exact symmetric-CP3 self-energy, and R=16 suffix-action selection all fail. Energy is best at native-J MSE 2.502644760e-7; action is 2.771014039e-7; both are far above the full carrier's 2.856783180e-8. The action proxy captures 81.2%-89.9% of its own score, confirming that original-column ranking is the wrong state.
record.terminal_criterion: Closed for rank-2,048 original-column summaries by the frozen rank-0 gate; larger selected-column follow-up is not justified.
